notes.title: Dungeon Knight Speed Run Competition!
notes.notes:
This will be a 4 week long competition in which people can record their speed runs of Dungeon Knight!!

Here you can see the speedrun leaderboard for Dungeon Knight
https://www.speedrun.com/dungeon_knight?h=Main_Game&x=wdmoj95k

Prizes: 
1st: $20 Steam Card, a Copy Of Dungeon Knight 2, and their name in the Dungeon Knight 2 Credits
2nd: $10 Steam Card, and their name in the Dungeon Knight 2 Credits
3rd: Their name in the Dungeon Knight 2 Credits

Note: Dungeon Knight 2 is still in development so rewards related to it might take longer to receive 

The videos can be posted on Youtube, Twitter, or send directly to me at StefanoGaming53@gmail.com Just make sure to tag them #DungeonKnight or #DungeonKnightSpeedRun

The timer should start as soon as the play button is pressed, and should end as soon as the player enters the final door that leads to the credits.

Also note: Box flying is allowed in all levels, however pausing the game to move the player or boxes will not be allowed.
